headline: How a 44-Year-Old Could Build a $9,000 Monthly Paycheck by 60 Without Maxing a 401(k)
summary: Retiring at 60 with a five-figure monthly paycheck sounds like it requires decades of maxing every tax-advantaged account you own, but a taxable brokerage and the right yield strategy can tell a very different story for a 44-year-old with 16 years on the clock.
